war_summary: On Day 125 of War 139, intense frontline combat is concentrated across key contested sectors with heavy attrition and rapid base turnover. Onyx is enduring an immense bloodbath with over 5,200 casualties in the last two hours and active contention over The Waif, while Callahans Passage and Speaking Woods show accelerating casualty rates and active territorial clashes. In the island and coastal sectors, Oarbreaker has erupted into a critical hotspot with nine base state changes in the past two hours around Grisly Refuge and Posterus. Clahstra continues to see relentless base flips and high casualties around Transept and Bewailing Fort, while Endless Shore maintains significant 24-hour turnover despite short-term casualty cooling.
